answer_2.quote: For image quality, we use (1) Structural Similarity (SSIM) and (2) Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) to measure the similarity between two images. Moreover, we use (3) CLIP Score to calculate the similarity between the text description of the item and the generated result as the textimage fidelity.

answer_3.quote: Leveraging the powerful capabilities and aesthetic judgment of ChatGPT 4o, we make it rank the generated results. We used a prompt-based approach ... to ask it to rank the input images.
methods: ranking the input images based on a prompt

answer_4.quote: To investigate whether users truly appreciate the generated movie posters, news posters, and outfits by I-AM-G, we conducted a human study ... where participants were asked to score the generation results with ranks.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were required to score the item images from 1 to 4, and score lower ranks to those they deemed better.
